in_english.name: Ruwwad
in_english.meaning: One of the migrants, the person who emigrates and moves
in_english.long_meaning: Ruwwad refers to one of the migrants who emigrated with the Prophet Muhammad to Medina. They were among the first Muslims and provided great support to the Prophet Muhammad during the Hijra to Abyssinia. When the Prophet Muhammad migrated from Mecca to Medina, the Ruwwad were among the first to migrate and resist the enemies, spread Islam, preserve the Quran, participate in the struggle, and sacrifice for the cause of Islam. This migration marked the beginning of Islamic history and the establishment of the Islamic state in Medina.
